Mental Health Care Plan Details
(Address each principal problem identified in Clinical Assessment - Section A. Add additional problems as relevant.)

Principal Problem: Health-related anxiety
- Patient Goal(s):
  • Reduce worry about serious illness  
  • Understand and manage migraine triggers
- Clinical Goal(s):
  • Decrease health anxiety symptoms (e.g., catastrophic thoughts, frequent reassurance seeking)  
  • Improve coping strategies and stress management
- Actions (Patient):
  • Keep headache diary (triggers, aura, pain scale, relief measures)  
  • Limit unverified internet searches; use provided reputable resources  
  • Practice daily relaxation (deep breathing, brief walks) – to be demonstrated/linked
- Actions (Clinician/GP):
  • Provide psychoeducation on migraine vs. red-flag symptoms  
  • Offer brief CBT-based strategies or refer to psychologist for health-anxiety focused CBT  
  • Review diary and anxiety symptoms at follow-up (next week)  
  • Consider short GAD-7 screening at follow-up (if indicated)

Secondary Problem: Work-related stress
- Patient Goal(s):
  • Feel more in control at work; reduce stress impact on health
- Clinical Goal(s):
  • Enhance stress-management skills; promote work–life balance
- Actions (Patient):
  • Schedule regular breaks; trial simple workplace relaxation (stretching)  
  • Explore available employee assistance program (if any)
- Actions (Clinician/GP):
  • Provide handout on stress management and exercise options  
  • Discuss graded exercise plan; encourage at least 30 min light activity, 3×/week  
  • Offer medical certificate if migraine episodes require short leave

Patient Education, Emergency Care & Relapse Prevention
- Education Given: Yes. Topics Covered: Migraine features vs. brain tumor red flags; analgesic use; stress and headache; reliable health information websites
- Early Warning Signs of Relapse/Worsening:
  • Increased frequency/severity of headaches not responsive to medication  
  • Escalating health worries; sleep disturbance; avoidance of work
- Coping Strategies:
  • Relaxation breathing, paced activity, social support contact, structured problem-solving, exercise

- GP Acknowledgment (if completed by other MH Professional): Not applicable
- Review Date: 1 week (follow-up appointment already suggested)
